newsitem.title: PERU: Lima Stock Exchange to extend operating hours.
newsitem.headline: Lima Stock Exchange to extend operating hours.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange will extend its trading session Monday to between 8 a.m. and 4 p.m. local time (9 a.m. to 5 p.m. EDT and 1300 to 2100 GMT.)
The bolsa is currently open for trading between 9 a.m. and 1 p.m. local time.
Bolsa President Jose Luque Otero said the decison was made so that trading on the Lima market could coincide with the New York exchange.
The decision would make easier the "imminent, simultaneous trading of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) and Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs)," he added.
The bolsa's new hours would be operative between July and September. From October to June, the bolsa would be stay open one hour later, until 5 p.m., Luque said.
